name: Jinan Shengquan Group Share Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinan Shengquan Group Share Holding Co., Ltd. is a diverse enterprise primarily focused on the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of various chemical and advanced materials. The company's product portfolio includes an extensive range of phenolic resins, which are utilized across numerous applications such as tire rubber, electronics, coated sand, composite production, friction materials, refractories, and abrasives. Additionally, it produces epoxy resins. In the foundry sector, Jinan Shengquan offers a comprehensive selection of materials. These encompass furan, alkaline phenolic, and cold box resins, along with crucial components like riser sleeves, coatings, filters, metallurgical substances, and auxiliary agents. Its foundry offerings are further complemented by porous cellulose and specialized SQ boards. Expanding beyond its core industrial chemicals, the company has a significant presence in the health industry, providing products such as heal fiber, VTS new materials, L-arabinose, D-xylose, and mother liquor. This segment also includes essential medical supplies like respirators, disposable face masks, and medical face masks. Furthermore, Jinan Shengquan is a contributor to the new energy sector, supplying advanced products like lithium titanate batteries, super capacitors, solar street lamps, and related modules. Its material science expertise also extends to biomass materials. Founded in 1979, the company is headquartered in Zhangqiu, China.
